channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Coastal Flood Advisory · Coastal Aransas, Coastal Kleberg, Coastal Nueces, Coastal San Patricio, Aransas Islands, Coastal Refugio and 4 more
item.description: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 20 at 10:44AM CST until November 21 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX. In effect until Nov 21, 6:00 PM CT. Areas: Coastal Aransas, Coastal Kleberg, Coastal Nueces, Coastal San Patricio, Aransas Islands, Coastal Refugio, Coastal Calhoun, Kleberg Islands, Nueces Islands, Calhoun Islands. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
